concept_options.title: What If You Doubled Your Money Every Day?
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-11 slate (f-money-doubles, 90/100, ranked 1st); the writer's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (SHE PAYS.)
concept_options.visual_approach: Lotte's bakery in Berlin at night, the city behind: you large at the left, grinning, the phone held up, its balance (1073741824, a billion cents) peeling off the screen as split-flap digits on a paper ribbon over the counter; Lotte behind the counter, chalk raised, shocked. Three thumbnail candidates a, b, c differ in the tag (SHE PAYS., STILL COUNTING., WORTH LESS.)
concept_options.hook: Day two, 7 a.m., Lotte's bakery in Berlin: your balance is two cents. Last night it was one. Every night, whatever is there doubles, and it will not stop.
